findings.title: Client proof still accepts uncorrelated claimed requests
findings.observation: The verifier requires only some record.requestIds value to appear in each Idea/project history and only some value to appear in the aggregate authoritative set. It never rejects the remaining request IDs, while transcript binding is plain substring presence and objective results remain labels.
findings.trigger: A proof record and structurally valid client transcript contain one request ID copied from a readable synthetic resource plus one or more invented IDs used to support claimed client actions.
findings.impact: The verifier returns PASS even though some claimed API actions have no authoritative correlation. A hand-written record can therefore reuse one real read to assert recovery/report/objective work that did not occur, defeating AC-15's no-static-substitution gate.

evidence.description: At exact head, a CODEX-shaped transcript and record containing one authoritative request ID and one invented request ID returned accepted=true; the fake ID was absent from the only audit history.
Idea, project and final authority checks all use Array.some rather than proving the required correlation for each recorded request ID.
The negative test uses a single unrelated request ID, so it misses the mixed one-valid-plus-one-invented case.

The exact committed Codex and Claude records independently pass with their real ignored transcripts and live proof API; this confirms the real evidence path works but does not close the validator bypass.
AC-15 and the approved plan require actual client execution and prohibit a hand-written/static substitute without live request/resource correlation.

findings.remediation: Define the exact correlation rule per objective and require every recorded successful request ID to exist in the matching Idea/project audit history. For rejected requests that intentionally have no audit event, parse and validate a client-specific transcript request/response event with the matching API path, status and requestId instead of accepting substring presence. Add an all-request set-difference failure and avoid treating objective labels as execution proof.
findings.verification: The current two real records still pass; a record with any invented extra ID, a valid ID attached to the wrong resource/path, or objective labels unsupported by parsed request/response evidence fails.

findings.title: Child-resource writes are committed without matching public reads
findings.observation: The current implementation maps every scenario result ref to a direct or paginated public read and requires an exact ID match.
findings.trigger: A normal, recovered or terminal-replayed journal entry contains a child resource reference.
findings.impact: The exact child must be publicly present before COMMITTED/PASS; missing or mismatched children now fail closed.

evidence.description: Exact report/progress reads pass, mismatched progress fails, and terminal replay performs zero writes while reading reports and progress.

findings.verification: Targeted unit tests and exact-head CI verify normal, recovery and terminal readback behavior.

findings.title: IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS is persisted as terminal rejection
findings.observation: The current recovery helper recognizes the bounded retry contract, preserves exact bytes/key and leaves exhaustion OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
findings.trigger: Recovery receives one or more 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS responses.
findings.impact: Temporary concurrency no longer becomes terminal local rejection and the original intent remains resumable.

evidence.description: The exact-head regression proves retry-success after two sends and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN after three bounded in-progress responses, with identical body and key.

findings.verification: Targeted unit tests and exact-head CI pass.

required_actions.action: Reject every uncorrelated claimed request and bind rejected/non-audited actions to parsed transcript request/response evidence.
Publicly reconcile each exact child resource before COMMITTED/PASS and on terminal replay.
Implement and test bounded IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS recovery with frozen bytes and key.
